card.name: Credit and thanks to people
card.fires_on: Small words like to or for (and nearby names) in acknowledgments, where credit, thanks or congratulations is being given to a person, team or funder.

modes.label: Linking word after credit or thanks
modes.description: The word to or for right after credit, thanks or congratulations, just before the person being thanked.
modes.example: a true credit<< to>> all the farmers who have worked so hard

modes.label: Inside acknowledged names
modes.description: A word or word ending within a named group or person being thanked or credited for support.
modes.example: generosity of individual donors and congreg<<ations>>. Please consider making a donation today.

card.plain: It lights up in thank-you and credit statements, just before the person or group being thanked is named.
evidence: a true credit<< to>> all the farmers who have worked so hard
